column1: NOTE 1:Io is the average across all the resource blocks within the AllowedMeasBandwidth in TS 36.331 [2].NOTE 2:Io1 is the Io level in the resource blocks other than central 6 resource blocks within the AllowedMeasBandwidth in TS 36.331 [2] and Io2 is the Io level in central 6 resource blocks. The Io1 and Io2 have the same range as defined for Io.NOTE 3:Iot is the received power spectrum density of total interference and noise for all the resource blocks, other than central 6 resource blocks.NOTE 4:The same bands and the same Io conditions for each band apply for this requirement as for the corresponding highest accuracy requirement.NOTE 5:The condition level is increased by ∆>0, when applicable, as described in Sections B.4.2 and B.4.3.NOTE 6:E-UTRA operating band groups are as defined in Section 3.5.
